Definition: Jashub, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jashub = "he will return"; 1) the 3rd son of Issachar and founder of the family of Jashubites; 2) one of the sons of Bani who had to put away a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
